notes: Fixes the v216 bug where users had to tap every phase again after swiping.
One tap on any center or side phase card now unlocks lower details globally for the whole carousel session.
After unlock, horizontal swipes automatically refresh the lower project/task preview for the active phase.
Completed phase still shows details by default before any tap.
Empty phases still show: No task was in this phase.
